newsitem.title: USA: Manchester to buy Bitwise unit.
newsitem.headline: Manchester to buy Bitwise unit.

text.p: Manchester Equipment Inc said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to buy Electrograph Systems Inc, a unit of Bitwise Designs Inc, for $2.5 million in cash.

It said consummation of this deal is subject to, among other things, completion of due diligence, negotiation of a definitive contract, board approval of both companies, and other necessary approvals.
Electrograph had about $16 million in sales for fiscal year ended June 30, 1996.
Electrograph is a specialized distributor of microcomputer peripherals, primarily in the eastern United States.
Manchester Equipment Co is a systems integrator and reseller of computer hardware, software and networking products, primarily for commercial customers.
